_comment: Name-register decomposition grid (2c follow-up). The full-JA n1/n2 prompts confound two failure axes: name-token rows (thin visits) and the general-tag rest of the prompt. Each character here gets up to three splits: *_mixed = JA character+copyright names, EN general tags (the realistic JP-user pattern — only the name spans route through ext rows); *_inverse = EN names, JA general tags (identity should survive via stock T5; measures what the non-name tokens cost); *_full = the original all-JA phrasing. miku is the positive control: `hatsune miku` is the corpus's best-supervised character, so if identity still fails on m1_full the visit-floor story for names is wrong. Consumed by bench/cjk_adapter/run_bench.py --prompts with --arms en,ja_t5en,ja_ext.
